summary: Repo-local `add-component` skill distills the validated Button pipeline into the standard order of operations for every future component: Paper spec via computed values, tokens before component, the API/a11y checklist, typed doc, mandatory BrandThemed story, type tests plus real-browser interaction tests, manifest/ledger, and the probe discipline (a gate is not evidence until it has been watched failing). Codifies the ratchet rule: review findings graduate to a type, then a CI gate, then a lint rule, and only last to prose. CI extended to run the utilities gate, Playwright browser tests and the Storybook build (a11y at error severity). Validation fixes alongside: button.doc.ts no longer references the not-yet-existing render slot and now records the isBusy visual-treatment gap explicitly instead of implying one exists.

migration.manual: None for consumers. Contributors: invoke the add-component skill at the start of any component work; AGENTS.md §Adding a component now points at it.
